description:
Work with most powerful agents in the world, with the UX they deserve

Craft Agents brings Claude’s coding capabilities to your entire digital workflow. It massively improves both coding and non-coding workflows via enhanced UI, review, and auto execution. Built on the same foundation as Claude Code (the Claude Agent SDK), it extends the model’s reasoning power to work across all your tools: GitHub, Linear, Slack, Craft documents, local files, and any API you can connect.
Features
- Craft Agents has a new home: thecraftagents.com — the app, downloads, auto-updates, shared session links, and documentation now live on the new domain. Updating to this version switches your app to the new update feed automatically; existing share links and sign-in flows keep working during the transition
- Documentation rebuilt as a fast static site — the docs at thecraftagents.com/docs are now a fully static site with instant search, same content and URLs as before
Improvements
- Agents now reference the product documentation via the public docs site instead of a built-in documentation source — one less background connection per session
